guide.title: How it works
guide.intro: SogaeBank is where you make referrals and earn referral fees. Individual members can do everything once they sign up and verify their identity; only industries that require a license to post (real estate agents, insurance, medical, etc.) need that license first.

s1.d: Individuals verify their identity, businesses verify with their business registration number, and our team approves. Before approval you can only browse.

s2.d: List what you can refer, or post what you need as a request.

s3.d: Our team checks it. Restricted industries cannot be listed.

s4.d: When a chat starts, a referral code is issued and referral credit begins.

s5.d: A deal is closed only when both sides confirm.

s6.d: The full referral fee goes to the referrer — the platform takes nothing.

agree.title: Agree to terms
agree.pendingN: {n, plural, one {{n} required term needs} other {{n} required terms need}} your consent.
agree.allDone: You have agreed to all required terms.
agree.neededBody: You need to agree to the required terms to use features that require login. Browsing, viewing terms and logging out still work. Optional items (marketing · personalized ads · night-time marketing messages) stay as they are.
agree.okTitle: You have agreed to all required terms
agree.okBody: You have agreed to the current versions. If the terms change, the changes will appear here and we will ask for your consent again.
agree.none: No terms have been published yet. We do not collect consent before publishing — if you agreed to a draft, you could not later confirm what you agreed to once the text changed.
agree.logged: The time of consent is recorded. If a dispute arises later over “I never agreed”, this record serves as evidence.
agree.optAnytime: You can change optional items at any time. Marketing messages and interest-based ads are not required, and withdrawing does not affect your use of the service.

form.reqHint: You cannot use the service without agreeing.
form.optHint: Not agreeing does not affect your use of the service.
form.needAll: You must agree to all required items to continue.

opt.toReject: “{title}” changed to declined. The change is recorded.
opt.toAgree: “{title}” changed to agreed. The change is recorded.
opt.hint: Each change adds a new record (never deleted or edited), and ads and notifications follow the most recent record. Required terms cannot be turned off here (only by deleting your account).

flows.title: How to use SogaeBank
flows.intro: Seven common tasks on SogaeBank, step by step. Step numbers show the real order, and the button takes you to that screen.

steps.1: Enter your email and password and agree to the terms (required and optional separately).
steps.2: Enter a referral code if you have one (optional).
steps.3: Verify your identity when you receive referral fees or post listings.
steps.4: See notifications, settlements and your referral tree in My Space.

steps.1: Choose a category and register a listing or request.
steps.2: It appears in the list after review.
steps.3: Get a referral code for each listing and share it with people you know.
steps.4: The deal and contract are completed.
steps.5: After your payout account is confirmed, the referral fee is paid.

steps.1: Choose a field (insurance, medical, rental, cleaning and more).
steps.2: Write your request, agree to third-party sharing and verify your phone.
steps.3: It is shared with one certified provider qualified in that field (kept 6 months, then deleted).

buy.t: Buy and return at Sogae Mall

steps.1: Pick products, add them to the cart, then order and pay.
steps.3: Request a return from your order history (shipping and refund rules shown on screen apply).

steps.1: Search questions or browse popular questions in the customer center.
steps.2: When you type a title in the inquiry form, similar questions appear first.
steps.3: If that does not help, send the inquiry.
steps.4: See the answer in My inquiries and mark it Solved or Not solved yet.

steps.1: Apply with your field, service area and documents.
steps.3: Top up Sogae Cash (refunds and tax invoices available).
steps.4: Receive consultation requests (leads) in the Partner Center, contact them, and reject wrong ones within 72 hours.

steps.1: Apply for affiliation and get approved.
steps.2: Get links and materials and share them.
steps.4: See members below you in the referral tree (names masked).
